title: Bruce Todd Wins Austin Mayor Race
summary:
*   Official results of Austin's May 18 run-off municipal election were declared, confirming new city leadership.
*   Bruce Todd was named Austin's new Mayor, securing the top position.
*   Ronney Reynolds won City Council Place No. 2, and Gus Garcia won City Council Place No. 5.
